aetheris.title: Aetheris
aetheris.summary: A modern banking app built with SwiftUI that simulates a complete financial experience — from authentication to transfers, cards and account management.
aetheris.overview: I wanted to go beyond simple UI challenges and build something closer to a real product. Aetheris was designed to practice architecting scalable features, handling complex banking flows and creating a clean, modern user experience.
goals: Simulate a complete banking experience end-to-end
Practice modular architecture and clean code
Design a consistent and accessible user interface
Implement robust states, validations and error handling

focusAreas.title: Manage your money in one place
focusAreas.description: See your balance, cards and recent activity at a glance with a clean, organized home.

focusAreas.title: Send and request with ease
focusAreas.description: Move money or request payments through simple, guided flows you can trust.

focusAreas.title: Track and understand spending
focusAreas.description: Get insights into your spending and habits with simple visuals and clear reports.
